meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将混乱代码改造成清晰结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 代码越来越乱,想在不改功能的前提下变得清晰好维护。
copy.tagline_en: Restructure messy code into a clear, maintainable design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase is messy and you want to clean it up without changing behavior.

howto.what: 装上它，Claude 处理代码改动时会按固定流程：先确认意图，再分析相关代码与依赖、检查测试覆盖，然后制定计划，逐步修改代码并在每步后运行测试与类型检查，最后跑完整测试和构建来确认没有破坏。
howto.when: 当用户要求重构、简化或提取代码等代码改造时触发；请求笼统（如“改进”“清理”）时，它会先反问具体目标。

say.text: 把 auth/handler.ts 里的 AuthService 拆成小类。
say.note: 它会先分析依赖，再逐步重构并测试。

say.text: 把这个文件里的校验逻辑提取成独立模块。
say.note: 它会先查看相关代码和测试情况再动手。

say.text: 把所有用到已废弃 API 的代码统一整理一下。
say.note: 这属于开放请求，它会先确认你的具体目标。

howto.what_en: Claude refactors code by: clarifying intent, mapping code and dependencies, checking test coverage, planning, then changing code stepwise with tests after each step, and finally running full tests and build.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to refactor, simplify, or extract code (or similar cleanup/modernization requests). Vague asks like 'improve' or 'clean up' make it ask for the specific goal first.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService in auth/handler.ts into smaller classes.
say_en.note: It maps dependencies first; then refactors and tests.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic from this file into a separate module.
say_en.note: It checks related code and tests before editing.

say_en.text: Clean up all code using the deprecated API.
say_en.note: Open-ended; it will clarify your exact goal first.
